description: This file defines the AsyncResultHandle class used internally for testing asynchronous result handling, including wait mechanisms based on flags with timeout capabilities.

classes.name: AsyncResultHandle
classes.description: A class for internal testing that manages asynchronous result state, including done and continue flags, exception, result, and wait methods with timeout.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the result handle by clearing exception, result, and flags.

methods.name: WaitForFinished
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the 'done' flag is set or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForContinue
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the 'continueFlag' is set or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitFor
methods.description: Core method that waits asynchronously with polling until a flag check returns true or the timeout is reached.
